text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 15: A power-lag column is the actual power shifted by its lag, and is null once the lead reaches the lag'
text.tspan: Figure 15: A power-lag column is the actual power shifted by its lag,
and is null once the lead reaches the lag

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'One ECMWF ensemble run from the validation year: the run whose PV farm mean actual power over its first 10 days is the median of the 53 runs. Top row: the actual power. Rows below: the four power-lag columns the production XGBoost model is given, each the actual power from 24, 48, 168, or 336 hours before the valid time. Power is a percentage of each series' effective capacity. A grey band marks the hours when the column is null, because the lag is no longer than the lead from the forecast's initialisation time, which is 9 hours after the ECMWF run's own initialisation time.'
